title: Photoacoustic-guided reflection-mode wavefront shaping through dynamic biological tissue
authors: Xuan Liu; Sacha Noimark; Wenfeng Xia; Sebastien Ourselin; Tianrui Zhao

Combines photoacoustic guidestar feedback with a real-valued intensity transmission matrix for same-side optical illumination and acoustic detection
Reports sub-second wavefront optimization, approximately 14-fold photoacoustic signal enhancement through a diffuser, and photoacoustic microscopy through ex-vivo tissue

summary_en: Combines a real-valued intensity transmission-matrix algorithm with a photoacoustic guidestar in reflection mode. A flexible multimode fiber passes through the central aperture of a focused ultrasound transducer, enabling same-side illumination and acoustic detection without a free-space combiner. The preprint reports sub-second optimization, about 14× PA-signal enhancement through a diffuser, and imaging of a ~100 μm wire through 2 mm of ex-vivo chicken tissue.
summary_cn: 将实值强度传输矩阵算法与光声导星结合，实现反射模式波前整形。多模光纤穿过聚焦超声换能器的中心孔径，使光照明与声学探测从样本同侧完成，无需自由空间合束器。预印本报告了亚秒级优化、穿过散射体约 14 倍的光声信号增强，以及透过 2 mm 离体鸡胸组织对约 100 μm 线目标的成像。
